svg.title: Before scaling, age runs from 25 to 52 and income from 42000 to 120000. Standard scaling subtracts each column's mean and divides by its standard deviation, so both land on the same axis around 0: age from -1.33 to 1.51 and income from -1.46 to 1.43.
svg.text: standard scaling puts every column on one axis
z = (value − column mean) / column std · filled: age · hollow: income
